"After some 30-40 minutes of trying to find a fair server, and after an additional 20-25 minutes of arguing over changed gibb-models, cheapo vs qizmo and so on ... the games actually got underway. =) As I remember it, Z got a pretty good start and took the lead quite early on, making better use of the spawnfrags they were offered by their positions. sLop from iBh (formerly Ocrana), played very well by the RA where he anchored the game from iBh's side." -Ego === DM2 === Clan Z: 152 - iBh: 179
[[Image:Ibh-z-dm2.jpg|320px]]

Demos: [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/c/cb/Ibh-z--dm2--123-20000210.qwz 1-2-3 (iBh)] | [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/6/6d/Ibh-z--dm2--flocutus-20000210.qwz Flocutus (iBh)] | [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/f/fd/Ibh-z--dm2--slop-20000210.qwz sLoP (iBh)]

"DM2 had iBh show of their best side with sLop and Flocutus racing to the top of the scoreboards and iBh getting a fairly large lead in the first part of the game. Then, once again, Z shows of their incredible abillity of making a comeback ... and making it good! A quaded sLop towards the end of the game provided the support iBh needed to take back parts of the level. Great game by iBh and Z!" -Ego === E1M2 === Clan Z: 201 - iBh: 152
[[Image:Ibh-z-e1m2.jpg|320px]]

Demos: [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/7/7b/Ibh-z--e1m2--123-20000210.qwz 1-2-3 (iBh)] | [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/9/9a/Ibh-z--e1m2--flocutus-20000210.qwz Flocutus (iBh)] | [https://www.quakeworld.nu/w/images/1/10/Ibh-z--e1m2--slop-20000210.qwz sLoP (iBh)]

"The tiebreaker! I did not know what to expect since I have seen both Z and iBh play really good on this level. 123 got a chance to show both skill and smarts as iBh leveled Z's lead and tied the game at 120 frags sometime around the last quarter of the game. The deciding factor I think was still Perkele who got what he described to be "a lucky quad" and wreaked havoc on the upper levels of the map. Z then proceeded to take a bunch of frags, iBh unable to keep up. Once again, great effort from both teams and congratulations to Z for victory over such a worthy opponent!" -Ego == Summary == * Score: 2-1 * Total frags ** Z: 513 ** iBh: 450 __NOTOC__ [[Category:Matchreports]]
